Gauss_law_source.electric_action: kappa sum_x E_x^2, defined by the open-chain axial-gauge Gauss elimination
Gauss_law_source.gauge_scope: Finite Gauss-eliminated one-dimensional matter/electric construction with fixed N3. No independent magnetic link dynamics or 3+1-dimensional Yang-Mills source is claimed.

calibration_ancestry: Exactly the selected five-input two-cell source is matched at L2 by the colour identity. Coefficients stay fixed as chain size changes; no additional masses or lengths are fitted.

exact_native_transfer_execution.spin_isospin_multiplet_extension: Local colour operators are spin/isospin scalars. Exact zero on the complete Ms0/Mi0 colour projector extends to every magnetic partner.

complete_native_records.all_colour_spin_charge_and_Fock_compleme: retained; zero success and unchanged failure outside the selected preparation
complete_native_records.idle_reference_charge: 0 for the selected neutral three-quark preparation
complete_native_records.input_domain: Uniform full native N3 carrier before colour preparation. Successful singlet records admit the zero-flux Gauss realization; coloured failures belong to the retained kinematic extension.

same_two_cell_source_transfer.domain: Every two-cell global colour singlet at any particle number, including the three-quark, six-quark and colour-neutral contact sectors. No equality of coloured complements or growing-chain spectra is asserted.
same_two_cell_source_transfer.exact_identity: On every two-cell global singlet, C0^2=C1^2 and (U-kappa/2)(C0^2+C1^2)+kappa*C0^2=U(C0^2+C1^2). The global-colour term vanishes. All colour-preserving contacts preserve this domain.

scope: Finite colour-singlet mass bands and native position-span records with an exact growing string cost. No physical length calibration, infinite-volume particle pole, pair creation or string-breaking law is established.

uniform_relative_confinement.all_ground_state_span_tail_rule: P(span>=R)<=min(1,C/R), C the exact reported bound, independent of chain length.
uniform_relative_confinement.domain: Fixed N3 total colour singlet and the admitted charge/spin projection; relative-coordinate confinement only, without a limit or fixed absolute centre.

comparison_inputs.quadrupole_role: Comparison central value from molecular hyperfine extraction; no precision fit is claimed.
comparison_inputs.shared_length_attachment: Conditional identification Q_physical=a^2 Q_graph and sigma=(4*kappa*electron_GeV/3)/a.
comparison_inputs.string_tension_role: Explicit illustrative benchmark supplied for the unit-elimination test, not an exact measured QCD input or parameter fit.

unit_elimination_control.scope: Conditional comparison identifying the finite graph quadrupole with the supplied physical benchmark and using one shared length. A source-specific obstruction for this transfer family; no general OPH or confinement no-go theorem.
